headline: Adipec Energy Event Concludes with $67 Billion in Deals
summary: The four-day Adipec energy conference concluded with $67 billion worth of deals signed, as energy security and artificial intelligence took center stage amid regional tensions.
why: Adipec is a major global energy gathering where large-scale hydrocarbons, infrastructure, and technology contracts are finalized.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Multi-billion-dollar contract announcements drive commercial activity across the global energy supply chain.
